g.data-exception-reason: Index uses explicit dot alternatives inside the same master. Continuous contours are sampled near2mm pitch with1.2mm design dots. Shared vessel contours take precedence at handle contacts; occluded handle samples are removed. Nearby samples below1.5mm centre distance are omitted to avoid doubled dots. Solid handle and lid knob retain clipped interior dot fields. These sampled alternatives preserve feature intent, not exact continuous stroke extent.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse all continuous geometry from the shared masters. Lower grey vessel areas under higher black contours distinguish object surfaces from the unraised kettle handle aperture and surrounding page. Pan handle and kettle knob remain higher solid areas. Bottle uses lower body with higher continuous boundary for consistent container exploration. No natural colour, contents or measured depth is implied.
